title: Children of Light, Awake
description: Children of Light, Awake in Tonic Solfa to SOUTHWELL, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Stephen Greenleaf Bulfinch wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 359 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “The Use of Present Opportunities”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to SOUTHWELL; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Child-ren of light, a-wake, At Je-sus' call a-rise, Forth with your lea-der to par-take His toils, his vic-to-ries.

lines: Forth with your leader to partake
Arm for the strife the feeble hand,
But toil must be the price;
Wilt thou not, servant of the Lord,
Strive till the prize be won;
Far spent already is the night;

licence: Public domain: Stephen Greenleaf Bulfinch died in 1870.
credits: Words by Stephen Greenleaf Bulfinch (1809–1870), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to SOUTHWELL by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
